schema.title: Response Launcher Challenge Api Launcher Challenge Get

get.description:
Consume a launcher-held receipt only after browser bootstrap succeeds.

The opaque receipt never enters the browser URL. The browser can only
advance it by consuming the separate one-time ticket and then making a
session-authenticated bootstrap request. This intentionally observes
protocol state, never a Chromium title, pixels, or accessibility tree.

schema.title: Response Request Host Shutdown Api V1 Host Shutdown Post

post.description:
Replace this Host after the response, without re-running UAC.

The process command and environment are owned by ``__main__``.  The
browser contributes no executable, path, command, or environment data.

post.summary: Reverify Blocked Engineering Mission Step V1
post.description:
User-only recovery for a false-negative blocked read step.

This changes no PLC/XG5000 state and deliberately creates no Agent run.
A later explicit user action remains necessary to continue the mission.

schema.title: Response List Change Transactions V1 Api V1 Change Transactions Get

post.description: Close one exact blank XG5000 instance without changing the recovery target.

schema.title: Response Export Engineering Symbols V1 Api V1 Engineering Symbols Export Post

post.description: Launch exactly one blank XG5000 instance without binding a workspace.
Explicitly close one displayed target; opening another remains separate.

CloseIdleXG5000InstanceRequestV1.title: CloseIdleXG5000InstanceRequestV1
CloseIdleXG5000InstanceRequestV1.description: Recovery-scoped request to close one proven blank XG5000 instance.

ConversationCompletionV1.title: ConversationCompletionV1
ConversationCompletionV1.description:
External completion state for a conversation's user-visible goal.

A completed Agent turn (and a published planning revision) is not the same
thing as completing the user's end-to-end goal.  The Host exposes this
distinction explicitly so clients cannot infer goal completion from a run
state or a planning publication alone.

EngineeringConversationHandoffV1.title: EngineeringConversationHandoffV1
EngineeringConversationHandoffV1.description:
Immutable planning-to-engineering provenance exposed to HTTP clients.

Reopen evidence was added after the first handoff records were persisted.
The fields are therefore nullable at this DTO boundary so a legacy record
can still be read.  New handoffs are constructed only from the Host's
accepted-native-project path, which requires and fills both values before
persistence; a partially populated pair is never accepted here.

EngineeringMissionBlockedStepReverifyReq.title: EngineeringMissionBlockedStepReverifyRequestV1
EngineeringMissionBlockedStepReverifyReq.description: Explicit user authority to reopen one durably blocked read step.

HostRestartResponseV1.title: HostRestartResponseV1
HostRestartResponseV1.description: Non-secret receipt for polling a Host-owned replacement.

LauncherReadinessV1.title: LauncherReadinessV1
LauncherReadinessV1.description: Launcher-only observation of a single browser bootstrap handoff.

ModelContextV1.title: ModelContextV1
ModelContextV1.description:
An explicit, provider-neutral context-capacity observation.

The Host may forward this projection when a trusted provider capability
source has actually measured the endpoint.  ``None`` is intentional: it
means the endpoint's capacity is unknown, not that the product requirement
has been met.  The contract keeps the 200k input requirement explicit so
callers cannot silently substitute the currently observed 196608 window.

OfflineOperandMissionV1.title: OfflineOperandMissionV1
OfflineOperandMissionV1.description: Host-owned typed intent for one evidence-derived offline LD operand edit.

safeState.title: Safestate
safeState.description: digital_input requires not_applicable; digital_output and internal_bit require on or off. This is a kind/safe_state relationship, not a prescribed safety-state choice for writable signals.

ProjectPlanLadderCompareConditionV1.title: ProjectPlanLadderCompareConditionV1
ProjectPlanLadderCompareConditionV1.description: A typed signed-16 LOAD comparison over D registers or constants.

ProjectPlanLadderConstantOperandV1.title: ProjectPlanLadderConstantOperandV1
ProjectPlanLadderConstantOperandV1.description: One literal in the native signed-16 comparison domain.

ProjectPlanLadderDataRegisterOperandV1.title: ProjectPlanLadderDataRegisterOperandV1
ProjectPlanLadderDataRegisterOperandV1.description: One directly addressed signed-16 data-register operand.

nativeSymbols.title: Nativesymbols
nativeSymbols.description: Optional ordered, model-authored native CSV symbol metadata. Supply explicit symbol, address, data_type and comment; this does not declare I/O, generate logic or infer timer/counter labels or native types.

ReconcileChangeTransactionRequestV1.title: ReconcileChangeTransactionRequestV1
ReconcileChangeTransactionRequestV1.description: Explicit XG5000 target for recovery-only reconciliation.

ReviewedNoSaveCloseRequestV1.title: ReviewedNoSaveCloseRequestV1
ReviewedNoSaveCloseRequestV1.description: Explicit user-confirmed close; it never implies opening another workspace.
